# Permissive licenses accepted for RUNTIME dependencies (what ships to users).
# Dev tooling is never distributed and is deliberately out of scope -- the CI job
# syncs with --no-dev before checking.
#
# These are the exact strings pip-licenses reports, which come from package
# metadata and are not normalised. Several packages declare compound SPDX
# expressions, which must be listed verbatim. That is brittle by design: if a
# dependency changes how it declares its license, this gate fails loudly and a
# human looks at it, which is the entire point.
MIT
MIT License
MIT-CMU
BSD
BSD License
BSD-2-Clause
BSD-3-Clause
0BSD
Apache-2.0
Apache 2.0
Apache Software License
ISC
ISC License (ISCL)
PSF-2.0
# The SIL Open Font License is permissive for our purposes: it explicitly allows
# bundling and redistributing a font alongside software, provided its notice travels
# with it. See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
SIL Open Font License 1.1 (OFL-1.1)
SIL OFL 1.1
OFL-1.1
Python Software Foundation License
The Unlicense (Unlicense)
CC0-1.0
CC0 1.0 Universal (CC0 1.0) Public Domain Dedication
# Compound expressions, verbatim:
Apache-2.0 OR BSD-2-Clause
BSD-3-Clause AND 0BSD AND MIT AND Zlib AND CC0-1.0
